reference: This argument is louder than the one about the sofa.
sk: Táto hádka je hlasnejšia ako tá o gauči.
cz: Tahle hádka je hlasitější než ta o gauči.
acceptable: This {argument|fight|quarrel} is louder than the one about the {sofa|couch}.

mistakes.text: This argument is more loud than the one about the sofa.
This argument is louder as the one about the sofa.
This argument is louder than that about the sofa.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Tá o gauči“ je „the one about the sofa“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Ta o gauči“ je „the one about the sofa“.

mistakes.text: This argument is loudest than the one about the sofa.
This argument is louder than the one on the sofa.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „O gauči“ je „about the sofa“, nie „on the sofa“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „O gauči“ je „about the sofa“, ne „on the sofa“.
